lines.zh: 布鲁压低身子贴地潜行
lines.en: Blue slinks low along the ground.

lines.zh: 爪子踩过落叶没有声音
lines.en: Her claws cross the leaves in silence.

lines.zh: 她侧头扫视每一处灌木
lines.en: She scans every bush with a tilt of her head.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尾巴平着扫过草。
lines.en: I lower my body and sweep my tail level through the grass.

lines.zh: 三步一停，嗅着空气
lines.en: Three steps, a pause, a sniff of air.

lines.zh: 布鲁绕着队伍外圈走
lines.en: Blue circles the outside of her pack.

lines.zh: 脚趾抓地，随时能扑出
lines.en: Toes grip the dirt, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 斑纹在草丛间忽隐忽现
lines.en: Her stripes flicker in and out of the grass.

lines.zh: 她踩上倒木，无声越过
lines.en: She crosses the fallen log without a sound.

lines.zh: 布鲁领着族人向前压
lines.en: Blue leads her kin forward at a stalk.

lines.zh: 布鲁昂头，鼻孔微微翕动
lines.en: Blue lifts her head and flares her nostrils.

lines.zh: 她单脚刨地，留下浅痕
lines.en: She rakes the dirt with one foot.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一串短促低鸣
lines.en: A string of short growls rolls in her throat.

lines.zh: 她盯着远处，一动不动
lines.en: She stares into the distance without moving.

lines.zh: 布鲁甩头，抖掉耳后的土
lines.en: Blue shakes the dust from behind her ear.

lines.zh: 她侧身擦过树干磨蹭鳞皮
lines.en: She rubs her hide against a trunk.

lines.zh: 我抬头，把风里的味道闻了一遍。
lines.en: I lift my head and taste the wind.

lines.zh: 布鲁张嘴，露出细密利齿
lines.en: Blue parts her jaws, baring fine teeth.

lines.zh: 她蹲坐下来，后腿仍绷着
lines.en: She settles down with her hind legs still coiled.

lines.zh: 那双黄眼在树影里发亮
lines.en: Those yellow eyes glow in the tree shade.

lines.zh: 她忽地转头，像听见什么
lines.en: She snaps her head around as if hearing something.

lines.zh: 布鲁把鼻子埋进泥土嗅闻
lines.en: Blue buries her snout in the soil to sniff.

lines.zh: 她打了个响鼻，喷出白气
lines.en: She snorts out a puff of warm breath.

lines.zh: 四肢轮流轻踏，保持热身
lines.en: She shifts foot to foot to stay warmed up.

lines.zh: 布鲁眯起眼，享受这片阴凉
lines.en: Blue narrows her eyes in the shade.

lines.zh: 她抬起前爪，舔了舔趾尖
lines.en: She lifts a foreleg and licks her toes.

lines.zh: 布鲁歪头打量你，像在称重
lines.en: Blue tilts her head, weighing you up.

lines.zh: 她瞳孔一缩，认出了你
lines.en: Her pupils shrink as she recognises you.

lines.zh: 目光从你脸上扫到腰间
lines.en: Her gaze slides from your face to your belt.

lines.zh: 布鲁低吼一声，不算欢迎
lines.en: Blue offers a low growl, not quite a welcome.

lines.zh: 她后退半步，给你留出距离
lines.en: She backs off a step to give you room.

lines.zh: 她鼻子凑近，嗅你的手背
lines.en: She leans in and sniffs your hand.

lines.zh: 布鲁盯着你，尾巴缓缓摆动
lines.en: Blue watches you, tail swinging slowly.

lines.zh: 她把头低到与你视线齐平
lines.en: She lowers her head level with your eyes.

lines.zh: 她发出两声短促的鼻音
lines.en: She gives two short, questioning huffs.

lines.zh: 布鲁绕着你走了半圈
lines.en: Blue circles you through half a turn.

lines.zh: 那双黄眼一眨不眨
lines.en: Those yellow eyes do not blink.

lines.zh: 她记得你的气味，所以没扑
lines.en: She knows your scent, so she holds back.

lines.zh: 布鲁吃痛，侧身跳开
lines.en: Blue jerks aside in pain.

lines.zh: 她吼了一声，牙全露出来
lines.en: She barks once, every tooth bared.

lines.zh: 受伤让她更谨慎，也更凶
lines.en: The wound makes her wary and meaner.

lines.zh: 她舔伤口，眼睛没离开你
lines.en: She licks the wound without looking away.

lines.zh: 布鲁后退，重新估算距离
lines.en: Blue backs off and recalculates.

lines.zh: 血珠从鳞缝里渗出来
lines.en: Blood beads out between her scales.

lines.zh: 她甩头，把痛感压下去
lines.en: She shakes her head to push the pain down.

lines.zh: 一声短促哀鸣被她咽回去
lines.en: She swallows a short, pained cry.

lines.zh: 她跛了半步，又站稳
lines.en: She limps half a step, then steadies.

lines.zh: 布鲁的呼吸变得粗重
lines.en: Her breathing turns rough and heavy.

lines.zh: 布鲁盯着你手里的肉咽沫
lines.en: Blue eyes the meat in your hand and swallows.

lines.zh: 她前爪刨地，却不肯先动
lines.en: She paws the ground but will not move first.

lines.zh: 闻到血味，她的瞳孔放大
lines.en: The smell of blood widens her pupils.

lines.zh: 布鲁慢慢凑近，脖子伸得很长
lines.en: Blue creeps closer with her neck stretched out.

lines.zh: 她绕到你侧面试探
lines.en: She circles to your flank to test you.

lines.zh: 一声短鸣，像在讨要
lines.en: A short chirp, almost a request.

lines.zh: 她的鼻尖几乎碰到食物
lines.en: Her snout almost touches the food.

lines.zh: 布鲁看看肉，又看看你的脸
lines.en: Blue looks at the meat, then at your face.

lines.zh: 她尾巴摇得比刚才更快
lines.en: Her tail swings faster than before.

lines.zh: 她耐心等你松手
lines.en: She waits patiently for you to let go.

lines.zh: 布鲁肩膀撞上你，力道不小
lines.en: Blue shoulders into you with real force.

lines.zh: 她贴着你转开，鳞皮擦过手臂
lines.en: She turns past you, hide scraping your arm.

lines.zh: 她被撞得侧退，随即稳住
lines.en: Knocked sideways, she recovers at once.

lines.zh: 布鲁低吼着把你顶开半步
lines.en: Growling, she nudges you back half a step.

lines.zh: 爪子在你靴边抓出印子
lines.en: Her claws leave marks beside your boot.

lines.zh: 她撞完就退，眼里全是试探
lines.en: She hits and withdraws, all testing.

lines.zh: 布鲁的尾巴扫过你的膝盖
lines.en: Blue's tail sweeps across your knee.

lines.zh: 两头撞在一起，她先让开
lines.en: They collide; she yields first.

lines.zh: 她借碰撞的力转身
lines.en: She uses the impact to spin around.

lines.zh: 布鲁把你挤到树干边
lines.en: Blue crowds you against the trunk.

lines.zh: 布鲁放低身子向同伴示好
lines.en: Blue lowers herself in greeting to her mate.

lines.zh: 她用鼻尖轻碰对方颈侧
lines.en: She touches her snout to her partner's neck.

lines.zh: 低鸣变成长长的呼应
lines.en: The low calls stretch into an answer.

lines.zh: 两头伶盗龙绕圈同步行走
lines.en: Two raptors circle in step.

lines.zh: 布鲁替伴侣理了理肩鳞
lines.en: Blue smooths the scales on her mate's shoulder.

lines.zh: 尾巴交叠，像一对手势
lines.en: Their tails cross like a pair of signals.

lines.zh: 她守着伴侣，警惕四周
lines.en: She guards her mate, scanning the treeline.

lines.zh: 布鲁把猎物推到对方面前
lines.en: Blue pushes the kill toward her partner.

lines.zh: 它们并肩蹭过头颅
lines.en: They brush heads side by side.

lines.zh: 这一刻的布鲁格外安静
lines.en: For once Blue is utterly quiet.

lines.zh: 布鲁叼起肉块，转身就走
lines.en: Blue snatches the meat and turns away.

lines.zh: 她低头把物品衔在齿间
lines.en: She dips her head and takes it in her teeth.

lines.zh: 爪子按住掉落物慢慢扒近
lines.en: A claw pins the dropped item and drags it close.

lines.zh: 布鲁把东西藏进灌木底下
lines.en: Blue stows it under the bushes.

lines.zh: 她叼着东西，尾巴翘得老高
lines.en: She carries it off with her tail held high.

lines.zh: 先嗅三下，才肯下口
lines.en: Three sniffs before she will take it.

lines.zh: 她衔起骨头，咬得咔咔响
lines.en: She picks up a bone and crunches it.

lines.zh: 抢到东西，她小跑着离开
lines.en: Prize in mouth, she trots away.

lines.zh: 布鲁用前爪把战利品拢成堆
lines.en: Blue rakes her spoils into a pile.

lines.zh: 她把东西埋进松土踩平
lines.en: She buries it in loose soil and stamps it flat.

lines.zh: 布鲁的头猛地转向你
lines.en: Blue's head snaps toward you.

lines.zh: 她锁定目标，身体前倾
lines.en: Locked on, she leans forward.

lines.zh: 一声尖啸划破林子
lines.en: A shriek cuts through the trees.

lines.zh: 她的爪子已经抓紧地面
lines.en: Her claws are already dug in.

lines.zh: 布鲁盯住猎物的喉咙
lines.en: Blue fixes on the throat of her prey.

lines.zh: 瞳孔缩成一条细缝
lines.en: Her pupils narrow to slits.

lines.zh: 她低伏下来，压住呼吸
lines.en: She flattens low and holds her breath.

lines.zh: 队伍里的其他成员散开
lines.en: The rest of the pack fans out.

lines.zh: 布鲁选了最短的扑击路线
lines.en: Blue picks the shortest line to pounce.

lines.zh: 喉咙深处滚出威胁
lines.en: A threat rumbles deep in her throat.

lines.zh: 尾巴僵直，成了平衡杆
lines.en: Her tail goes stiff as a balance pole.

lines.zh: 她算准了你退路的方向
lines.en: She picks the way you will retreat.

lines.zh: 布鲁把你围进了包围圈
lines.en: Blue has folded you into the ring.

lines.zh: 她开始数你的脚步
lines.en: She starts counting your steps.

lines.zh: 双方对视，谁都没有先动
lines.en: Both sides stare; neither moves first.

lines.zh: 布鲁后腿蓄力，肌肉隆起
lines.en: Muscle bunches in her hind legs.

lines.zh: 她不会再给你第二次机会
lines.en: She will not grant a second chance.

lines.zh: 目标已定，她不再犹豫
lines.en: Target chosen, she stops hesitating.

lines.zh: 布鲁跟着你平移，始终正对
lines.en: Blue sidesteps to keep you dead ahead.

lines.zh: 她压低重心，等你露出破绽
lines.en: She sinks her weight, waiting for a gap.

lines.zh: 一步两步，她贴近了
lines.en: One step, two, and she closes in.

lines.zh: 她试着从左侧绕过去
lines.en: She tests a path around your left.

lines.zh: 布鲁忽然加速又停住
lines.en: Blue darts in and stops short.

lines.zh: 她在找你的护甲缝隙
lines.en: She hunts for a seam in your armour.

lines.zh: 喉间的低吼一直没停
lines.en: The growl in her throat never stops.

lines.zh: 她盯着你的膝盖，那里最软
lines.en: Her eyes drop to your knees, the soft spot.

lines.zh: 布鲁用尾巴试探风向
lines.en: Blue tests the wind with her tail.

lines.zh: 她和同伴交换一声短鸣
lines.en: She trades a short call with her pack.

lines.zh: 她故意撞响旁边的石头
lines.en: She deliberately clatters a stone.

lines.zh: 你转身，她已换了方位
lines.en: You turn; she has already moved.

lines.zh: 布鲁一步步收紧距离
lines.en: Blue tightens the distance step by step.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸平稳得可怕
lines.en: Her breathing stays horribly even.

lines.zh: 她就等你自己先跑
lines.en: She is waiting for you to run first.

lines.zh: 每一次佯攻都更近一点
lines.en: Each feint ends a little closer.

lines.zh: 布鲁忽然伏地，像要扑
lines.en: Blue drops flat as if to spring.

lines.zh: 她把你的退路全看过了
lines.en: She has already mapped your exits.

lines.zh: 两位同伴在你身后呼应
lines.en: Two packmates answer behind you.

lines.zh: 布鲁不急着动手，在磨你
lines.en: She is in no hurry; she is wearing you thin.

lines.zh: 布鲁腾身而起，后爪先到
lines.en: Blue leaps, hind claws leading.

lines.zh: 镰刀似的趾爪撕开空气
lines.en: Her sickle claw tears the air.

lines.zh: 她咬你肩头，牙磕在甲上
lines.en: She bites your shoulder; teeth ring on armour.

lines.zh: 一击不中，她顺势翻滚
lines.en: Missing, she rolls clear.

lines.zh: 布鲁借冲势把你撞退
lines.en: Blue slams you back with her momentum.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，抽在你腰侧
lines.en: Her tail whips across your ribs.

lines.zh: 她抓完立刻退开半步
lines.en: She strikes, then gives ground at once.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬空的脆响很近
lines.en: The dry click of her teeth lands far too near.

lines.zh: 布鲁两次撕咬连成一气
lines.en: Blue chains two bites into one motion.

lines.zh: 她跳上护甲，寻找缝隙
lines.en: She springs onto your armour, hunting a gap.

lines.zh: 爪子拖出四道白痕
lines.en: Her claws leave four white scores.

lines.zh: 她收势极快，几乎不露背
lines.en: She recovers so fast her back is never open.

lines.zh: 布鲁用头顶你，等你失衡
lines.en: Blue butts you, waiting for a stumble.

lines.zh: 一声嘶吼伴着这次扑击
lines.en: A snarl rides along with the pounce.

lines.zh: 草丛里先亮起两点黄光
lines.en: Two yellow points light up in the grass.

lines.zh: 布鲁从蕨叶间站起身
lines.en: Blue rises out of the ferns.

lines.zh: 她甩掉背上的落叶
lines.en: She shakes the leaves off her back.

lines.zh: 一条尾巴先扫开灌木
lines.en: A tail sweeps the brush aside first.

lines.zh: 低鸣从林子深处传来
lines.en: A low call drifts out of the deep wood.

lines.zh: 她的斑纹先于身影出现
lines.en: Her stripes show before her shape does.

lines.zh: 布鲁踩断枯枝，故意让你听见
lines.en: Blue snaps a dry twig so you hear her.

lines.zh: 她从石缝后探出头
lines.en: She pokes her head from behind a boulder.

lines.zh: 未干的泥还挂在她爪上
lines.en: Wet mud still clings to her claws.

lines.zh: 她停在林线打量这片空地
lines.en: She halts at the treeline to study the clearing.

lines.zh: 布鲁的呼吸在林中很清楚
lines.en: Her breathing is loud in the quiet wood.

lines.zh: 她是从更深的谷地爬上来的
lines.en: She has climbed up from a deeper valley.

lines.zh: 四道影子在林间散开
lines.en: Four shadows scatter through the trees.

lines.zh: 布鲁走在最前面
lines.en: Blue walks at the very front.

lines.zh: 她的爪子在泥土上刻下记号
lines.en: Her claws score marks in the dirt.

lines.zh: 一个新气味让她停住
lines.en: A new scent pulls her up short.

lines.zh: 她绕着这片地走了一圈
lines.en: She paces a full circle around the ground.

lines.zh: 布鲁抬起鼻子，记住了你
lines.en: Blue lifts her nose and remembers you.

lines.zh: 树林安静下来，只剩她的脚步
lines.en: The wood goes quiet but for her steps.

lines.zh: 她走进了不属于她的地盘
lines.en: She has walked into ground that is not hers.

lines.zh: 布鲁闻到焦味，慌忙抖身
lines.en: Blue smells scorched hide and shakes herself hard.

lines.zh: 落地时她前爪一软跪下去
lines.en: She lands and her forelegs buckle.

lines.zh: 她被水呛到，猛地甩脑袋
lines.en: She chokes on water and whips her head.

lines.zh: 冲击把她掀翻进灌木
lines.en: The blast flings her into the brush.

lines.zh: 箭矢擦过肩头，带走一片鳞
lines.en: An arrow grazes her shoulder, taking scales.

lines.zh: 陌生的灼感钻进骨头，她低吼
lines.en: Strange heat seeps into her bones; she snarls.

lines.zh: 饿得发昏，她的步伐开始摇晃
lines.en: Half-starved, her stride starts to sway.

lines.zh: 雷击让她僵直，鳞片全炸起
lines.en: The bolt locks her stiff, scales standing up.

lines.zh: 虚空拉扯她，她拼命抓向地面
lines.en: The void pulls; she claws desperately for ground.
